description: This file is a Perl script that functions as a replacement for 'brcmImagebuilder'. It appears to generate firmware images for specific hardware, incorporating features such as image headers, padding, and optional dual images or multiple partitions.

methods.name: Read_Image
methods.description: Reads entire contents of a file into a scalar (slurp mode)

methods.name: Padlen
methods.description: Calculates the padding needed to align data to a specified byte boundary

methods.name: Pad
methods.description: Pads a buffer with 0xFF bytes to reach a specified length

methods.name: bcmImage
methods.description: Constructs a firmware image with proper headers, CRC, and optional dual image and partitioning
